<!-- pr-reviewer: 8b54f13794103525f03851aab9b1cdc90c6ad296 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

What looks good
- Data-only fix: two machine files restated, checker untouched; rule written into the `app::machine` module doc and `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`.
- Same convention as the Tormach files, so all shipped mills read one way.
- Two pinning tests: the issue's repro posts, and Z 520 still refuses by name.
- Body complete (`Changelog:`, `Fixes #457`), decision file in `docs/decisions/`, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes.
- Lathe and mill-turn left alone and split out to #493.

Local results (merged with current main, clean merge, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| vmc_stroke | 2 passed |
| machine | 32 passed |
| machine_library | 11 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| tormach_post | 10 passed |
| tormach_machines | 5 passed |
| tilt | 8 passed |
| rotary_verify | 9 passed |
| post_not_judged | 4 passed |
| setup_sheet | 7 passed |
| inverted_post | 15 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Widening to `-L..L` means the checker now accepts moves up to L either side of the work origin, so it no longer catches a program that exceeds the real machine-frame stroke when the offset sits near one end. The PR and decision file state this trade-off and defer an absolute check to an enhancement; worth that enhancement being filed.
- Not exercised: GUI, MCP repro, ui suites (ui untouched).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
